name: MEV bot 0xd61492 router unauthenticated command entry
summary: The bot's vault 0xd614927a ("BBVault") accepts commands only from its router 0x8db0efee. The router's entry 0x0582f20f runs a caller-supplied command program for any caller, including DELEGATECALL to caller-chosen code. An attacker contract called the router and had the vault take flash loans from a fake Aave-style pool it had just deployed. The vault approved that pool for each repayment, and the pool used the allowances to pull the vault's WBTC, WETH, ARB, DAI, USDT and USDC.e to the attacker.

loss.notes: Exact net depletion of vault 0xd614927acfb9744441180c2525faf4cedb70207f in source-1, equal to the attacker EOA's receipts. The flash-loan legs through the fake pool and router net to zero. WBTC, WETH, DAI and USDT use the contemporaneous Ethereum-mainnet DefiLlama quotes, because DefiLlama has no historical Arbitrum quote for those tokens at this time. The router's 2 base-unit USDC.e debit is omitted as de minimis.

ageReset.description: Direct, non-upgradeable router runtime. Its 0x0582f20f entry performs no caller check and reads no storage before acting, so it has been open since deployment. The vault 0xd614927a (deployed earlier, block 85716881) trusts the router by design and is not the later reset.

limitations: Router and vault have no verified source. The missing caller check comes from the struct-log trace of the router frame and from a newly created attacker contract's successful call, not from source text.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Source-1 (block 117708229, index 1) is a contract creation by EOA 0x826b180cd3d6fd0a646875f920bb2cf52b7f0b0b. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): 0x2c53ca7d creates 0x3c236c91, which creates fake pool 0x0930c3ac, reads the vault's balances and takes a Balancer flash loan (0x5c38449e). In receiveFlashLoan it CALLs router 0x8db0efee6a7622cd9f46a2cf1aedc8505341a1a7 0x0582f20f with a packed command program. The router calls vault 0xd614927acfb9744441180c2525faf4cedb70207f 5224372c/410085df and six times 512b7351 (flashLoan(address,address,uint256,uint256[],bytes)) naming the fake pool. Each time the vault calls pool ab9c4b5d, the pool calls back vault executeOperation 920f5c84, and the vault approves the pool (095ea7b3). The router also DELEGATECALLs attacker code 0x3c236c91 (selector 0x4da91757). The pool then transferFroms the vault's balances to 0x826b180c (receipt logs 45, 48, 52, 54, 56, 59). debug_traceTransaction with disableStorage/disableMemory, router frame from struct-log step 19881: after selector dispatch the only CALLER use (pc 2152) compares the caller with the router's own address and is false. There is no SLOAD before the first vault CALL; EQ checks compare program operands with code constants 0x6976f5fe2791b31bf64c0e7ace807c9299d3863a, 0x3c6ef5ed8ad5df0d5e3d05c6e607c60f987fb735 and 0x3f56e0c36d275367b8c502090edf38289b3dea0d. The vault gates the router: eth_call vault 5224372c(0x6976f5fe2791b31bf64c0e7ace807c9299d3863a, USDC.e, 0) at block 117708228 reverts 'BBVault: FORBIDDEN' from 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD and succeeds from the router. Identity/age: eth_getCode router empty at 86059816, keccak 0x2d9cc8e47bd922dca55b2f3627f3b37b1c6f61bf21da6a3e7602c24fb5bae73d (14867 bytes) at 86059817 and 117708228; source-2 (block 86059817, index 3) is its top-level creation by vault owner 0x42657c74d0fc99baf2b313cfa245a1c8e4ce1afb, who also created the vault (0x8555c9f6b57567d75f40514bf12f6d0a62f12974c8b32c905e42a1dfd574f640, block 85716881; vault runtime keccak 0x4aca274d81f43e680557e9ad964ccc44462fbfefed5af36d842a7609567d2971 unchanged at 117708228). Earliest exercise: Etherscan txlist of the router has 828 transactions. Every successful pre-exploit call is 0x0582f20f from one of 10 EOAs whose first inbound transfer is 1-2 ETH from 0x42657c74, plus two owner txs; the last is at block 87917092. Attacker EOA 0x826b180c's only prior tx is its funding at block 117699365. Vault token history before source-1 (340 transfers) sends to pools, Balancer, the router and owner wallet 0x6976f5fe; no transfer goes to an attacker address.

Reviewed loss. Source-1 receipt: fake pool 0x0930c3ac transfers 2x each vault balance in (logs 13/18/23/28/33/38) and the vault forwards the same amounts to the router (logs 14/19/24/29/34/39), netting to zero. The vault then loses to 0x826b180c: WBTC 454254371 (8 dec, log 45), WETH 117327292903619526083 (log 48), ARB 46093283365548135712 (log 52), DAI 4690988963441431131483 (log 54), USDT 209896002192 (6 dec, log 56), USDC.e 285269131767 (6 dec, log 59). Per-token net vault change over all receipt Transfer logs equals minus these amounts. Prices are DefiLlama historical at 1691058324 (source-5 to source-10). Valuation timestamps are the requested historical time; the returned quote times are 1691058462 (WBTC), 1691058466 (WETH), 1691058458 (ARB), 1691058300 (DAI, USDT) and 1691058281 (USDC.e).
